name: iamyou-signal
description: Rest, stress or exercise from a 30-second wrist window, judged against the person's own seated baseline.

data.source: PhysioNet Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions v1.0.1 (Empatica E4)

window.acc_units: magnitude sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2) of raw counts / 64, in g
window.baseline: hr_mean, eda_mean, temp_mean averaged over 30-second windows (10 s hop) in the last 180 s of a seated rest

features.hr_slope: least-squares slope of HR against time (bpm/min)
features.eda_rise: sum of positive sample-to-sample EDA steps (uS)
features.temp_slope: least-squares slope of skin temperature (degrees C/min)
features.acc_std: standard deviation of ACC magnitude (g, ddof 0)
features.acc_jerk: mean absolute ACC magnitude step times 32 Hz (g/s)
features.snap: each input x is replaced by floor(x * input_snap_scale + 0.5) / input_snap_scale before the trees (a 2^-30 grid; removes float rounding noise)

output: probabilities = softmax(baseline_prediction + sum of trees[i][k] for each class k)

tree_layout.trees: trees[iteration][class index], one regression tree per class per iteration
tree_layout.f: feature index into features.order; -1 marks a leaf (is_leaf)
tree_layout.t: split nodes: threshold, x <= t goes left; leaves: leaf value (learning rate applied)
tree_layout.m: 1 if a missing (NaN) input goes left, else 0
tree_layout.rounding: leaf values rounded to 11 decimals; each threshold shortened to the shortest decimal within a quarter of the gap between the training values it separates, so every training window stays on the same side

evaluation.method: leave-one-subject-out: each subject scored by a model trained without them

reference.model: train.py hgb/personal_levels: max_depth 4, 300 iterations (about 540 KB as JSON)

evaluation.size_selection: smallest candidate (depth 2-4, 4-16 leaves, 20-300 iterations) whose LOSO balanced accuracy and stress-vs-rest AUC are within 0.005 of the reference, macro F1 at most 0.005 lower and log loss no worse; table in export/shrink_search.json
